_ident.product: Bedside Sleeper with Play Yard Extension

result.headline: CPSC recall: Papablic convertible bedside sleepers pose entrapment, suffocation and fall hazards.
result.safety_note: CPSC announced a recall of Papablic convertible bedside sleepers with play yard extensions, model PAPA03001AI, on October 15, 2026 (about 248 units). CPSC says the products violate the mandatory standard for play yards and that the latching and locking mechanism can fail, causing the product to collapse. The remedy is a refund.
